# Spark Control Center 1.4.2

## Workflow and template versions

- Restore switches the current version pointer without creating another snapshot.
- Version previews identify the viewed version and disable its deletion; the current version is always protected.
- Editing a historical snapshot allocates a number above the persistent high-water mark, including deleted versions.
- Remove the runtime-values YAML tab. Configure defaults and logical-time expressions in parameter definitions; template-backed nodes can customize defaults without changing template constraints.
- Improve user identity-column width, wrapping and fixed-column layout.

## Durable serial backfills

- Preview only the first 50 occurrences; confirm the entire range without the former 200-instance cap.
- Persist frozen workflow configuration, cursor and progress in PostgreSQL and resume after backend replacement.
- Run occurrences serially in oldest-first or newest-first order; choose stop-on-failure or continue-on-failure.
- Give normal scheduled instances higher priority within the same workflow, without interrupting an already-running instance.
- Browse progress and cancel future generation in project execution history. Cancelling a request retains existing instances.

The range remains limited to 366 days. Large second-level ranges can generate many jobs; review the Cron and execution strategy before confirmation. Back up PostgreSQL before upgrading. Startup adds compatible version-counter and backfill tables/columns. See the [workflow guide](https://github.com/ApolloMeridian/spark-application-webui/blob/v1.4.2/docs/en/WORKFLOWS.md).

## Documentation and distribution

- Separate complete English and Simplified Chinese guides under `docs/en` and `docs/zh-CN`, with matching README links.
- Organize screenshots by application operations, automation and governance.
- Remove checksum assets from historical releases. CI publishes only two image archives and the Helm package, with no private registry prefix.
